summary.text: Rachael Dowling is an independent candidate for Wisconsin State Assembly District 53 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Becky Nichols and Republican David Daniels in a race with no incumbent.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a small business owner since 2007 and a three-term Winnebago County Board supervisor.

paragraphs.text: Dowling graduated from Christian Liberty Academy and is an FAA-certified drone pilot, according to Ballotpedia.

In the survey, she said she is a mother of four, a member of the Winnebago County Health & Human Services Board, an East Central Wisconsin Regional Planning Commission appointee, and a former Northeast Wisconsin Technical College academic advisor.
Dowling named affordability, responsible development and housing as her three campaign messages.
She said she supports eliminating Wisconsin's minimum markup requirement on gasoline and does not support large data centers that leave communities bearing the costs.
She also said she wants to expand housing choices and direct more state dollars to local roads, sidewalks and infrastructure.
